lead_raw_text:
The structure of RbMg(CuS₂)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 22 atoms—Rb₂Mg₂Cu₄S₈—distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers in tetrahedral coordination by four S neighbors, while Rb centers adopt an 8-vertex coordination environment and Mg centers are coordinated by four S neighbors. The Cu tetrahedra and S-centered tetrahedra display corner- and edge-sharing contacts, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 22 sites.
